highlights: Ugreen 45W GAN Fast Wall Charger USB-C Port  - 65056B

The UGREEN 45W GaN USB-C wall charger is a compact and powerful charging solution designed for modern devices. Using advanced GaN technology, it delivers faster charging with improved efficiency and lower heat compared to traditional chargers. Its multi-port design allows simultaneous charging of multiple devices, making it ideal for daily use, travel, and work setups.
45W fast charging output suitable for smartphones, tablets, and lightweight laptops
GaN technology for higher efficiency and reduced heat generation
Supports Power Delivery (PD), PPS, and Quick Charge protocols
Intelligent power distribution for optimized charging performance
Built-in safety protections against overcurrent, overheating, and short circuits
